title: Experimental Procedure of Household Activities and Physical Activity
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jatcien

steps.title: Explain and practice SCWT
steps.instruction: Explain the Stroop Color‑Word Test (SCWT) to each participant and have them practice 10 sheets (6 congruent, 4 incongruent) by viewing one word per screen, responding, and pressing the Enter key to advance.

steps.title: Place fNIRS optodes
steps.instruction: Cover the participant’s frontal area with optodes: anchor the lower‑center probe at Fpz (10‑20 system), attach 27 optodes (14 emitters, 13 detectors) for 42‑channel cortical measurement with 3.0 cm detector spacing, and add three detector‑only optodes (right, middle, left of prefrontal cortex) for skin blood flow with 1.5 cm spacing.

steps.title: Run baseline SCWT recording
steps.instruction: With the participant seated, chin on the holder, conduct the SCWT for a total of 5 min 30 s using a block design: 30 s task block (three congruent and three incongruent blocks, contents randomized, start block counterbalanced) followed by 20 s rest block, repeated for seven rest blocks; after each response, press Enter to advance.

steps.title: Record sitting heart rate
steps.instruction: Measure the participant’s heart rate while they remain seated.

steps.title: Perform household‑activity vacuuming
steps.instruction: In a 2.2 × 1.8 m area containing 8 g of paper shreds and 100 plastic balls (6 mm diameter), instruct the participant to retrieve the vacuum cleaner, plug in the cord, vacuum the floor as completely as possible for 10 min, then unplug and return the vacuum; record heart rate every 2 min during the task.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve vacuum cleaner and plug in cord.
Vacuum the dirty floor for 10 min.
Unplug cord and return vacuum cleaner.
Record heart rate at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 min.

steps.title: Rest after HA task
steps.instruction: Allow the participant to sit quietly for a 5‑minute rest period.

steps.title: Repeat SCWT before control task
steps.instruction: Conduct the same SCWT block design (5 min 30 s) as described earlier, prior to the control vacuuming motion.

steps.title: Perform control vacuuming motion
steps.instruction: In the same 2.2 × 1.8 m area (clean floor, no debris), have the participant retrieve only the vacuum cleaner, imitate vacuuming motions for 10 min, then return the vacuum; record heart rate every 2 min during the motion.

substeps.instruction: Record heart rate at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 min.

steps.title: Rest after control task
steps.instruction: Allow the participant to sit quietly for a 5‑minute rest period.

steps.title: Collect accomplishment rating
steps.instruction: After the household‑activity experiment, ask the participant to rate their feeling of accomplishment on a 5‑point Likert scale.

steps.title: Localize fNIRS channel coordinates
steps.instruction: Use a 3D digitizer (FASTRAK, Polhemus) to register channel coordinates to the MNI template via probabilistic registration; assign six ROIs: right frontopolar (channels 21, 29, 38), left frontopolar (22, 31, 39), right dorsolateral (2, 3, 11, 12), left dorsolateral (6, 7, 14, 15), right ventrolateral (18, 35, 36), left ventrolateral (25, 41, 42).

steps.title: Preprocess oxy‑Hb signals
steps.instruction: Convert oxy‑Hb data to numerical values, perform baseline correlation in LABNIRS using the 0‑ to 5.0‑s rest period before task onset, remove skin blood flow via segment‑independent component analysis (separate 42 cerebral channels from 3 skin channels), select the component with spatial uniformity coefficient > 0.5 among cerebral components and remove the highly correlated component, then smooth the resulting oxy‑Hb signals with a moving average to suppress heart‑rate and respiration noise.

steps.title: Record supine heart rate
steps.instruction: On a separate day, have the participant lie supine, rest for 15 min for relaxation, then measure heart rate for 1 min while they remain silent and minimize movement.
